relations.subject: server:log-collection-task
relations.evidence: This command cancels the currently running log collection task.

notable_absence.finding: As with every other file in this batch, no specific RBAC role or privilege is named for stopping a log collection task - only the generic 'unauthorized error' boilerplate. The DESCRIPTION is a single sentence with no statement of what becomes of partially-collected logs on nodes where collection had already finished before the cancel.

cross_component_finding: The thinnest page in the collect-logs trio: a one-sentence DESCRIPTION, the universal six-flag OPTIONS boilerplate, and a single bare EXAMPLES command - mirroring the same terseness pattern seen in rebalance-stop.md. This reinforces the batch-wide observation that '-stop' subcommands are consistently the least-elaborated member of their sibling sets (rebalance-stop and collect-logs-stop both collapse to a single sentence), while the corresponding '-status' subcommands vary (rebalance-status is equally terse, but collect-logs-status is unusually detailed because it must specify a literal output format).
cross_product_finding: Not addressed on this page - no comparison to Capella is made.
